title: Sequential AB probing and replayable eval bus for rerank quality
creator: Alicia Monroe
description: Goal: build a lightweight, replayable evaluation bus that captures live rerank traffic samples for sequential A/B probing and offline NDCG/MRR replays. This ticket wires up a sampling layer at the rerank endpoint that marks, stamps, and persists candidate lists + embeddings + model metadata to a low-cost event store; provides deterministic replay tooling for offline k-fold NDCG/MRR calculations; and adds A/B hooks so experiments can be driven from the Console. Motivation: current rerank evals rely on periodic dumps and ad-hoc scripts which are slow to iterate and hard to reproduce. We want reproducible, per-customer promptset slices, deterministic random seeds for pairing, and low-latency capture without adding >5ms p95 to serving latency.
acceptance_criteria: sampling implemented at rerank endpoint with configurable rate and per-customer override
events persisted to a replayable store (immutable, time-indexed) with schema versioning
deterministic replay tool produces identical candidate ordering given same seed and model snapshot
NDCG and MRR batch job runs on replay data and publishes per-customer deltas to telemetry
A/B hooks available so Console can toggle probe cohorts and tag experiments
end-to-end p95 added latency from sampling < 5ms at 99th percentile in staging
comments: 2025-02-13 Alicia Monroe: Kickoff — scoped sampling + replay store. Proposed event payload: request_id, customer_id, prompt_id, candidate_ids, candidate_scores, embeddings_hash, model_version, routing_policy, timestamp, seed, schema_version. Asked infra for retention sizing.

2025-02-18 Ravi Patel: Spike complete. Prototype uses compact Avro envelope written to S3 via a write-ahead Kafka topic. Trade-offs: Kafka gives low tail latency but adds infra complexity; S3-on-write simplifies repro and snapshotting. Decided to start with Kafka-forwarder to S3 to get live tail and archival snapshots.

2025-02-21 Design review (Maya Chen): Added a minimal UI contract for Console to select probe cohorts and view sampling rates. Design asks for per-route toggle and a preview of expected queries/sec sampled.

2025-02-25 PM feedback (Daniel Ortiz): Prioritize deterministic seed behaviour and per-customer holdouts for enterprise customers. Flagged compliance note: ensure that PII is hashed/stripped before persisting. Assigned to security for sign-off.

2025-02-28 Security review (Lena Gómez): Confirmed PII policy: prompt text must be redacted or stored as one-way hashed blob when customer requests. Added optional field redaction_level in the event schema. No blocking issues.

2025-03-01 Eng update (Ravi Patel): Implemented sampling header propagation and proto -> Avro conversion. Integration tests added. Local replay CLI can run replays against a model image and emit NDCG/MRR JSON. Perf: added ~3.2ms median and 4.9ms 99th in staging lightweight runs.

2025-03-03 QA (Priya Singh): Running end-to-end replays on two customer promptsets. Observed one nondeterministic mismatch traced to timestamp truncation in candidate hashing. Patch landed to include seed+model_version in hash computation. CI jobs queued for regression tests.

2025-03-04 PM note (Daniel Ortiz): Planning to expose A/B toggles in Console beta for a set of early access customers after next staging validation. Targeting customer-facing docs draft by 2025-03-10.
